english.title: Unacceptable behaviour in the Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst in the

(A)_[Blackwall]
(B)_[Silvertown]

tunnel area,

(C)_[climbed upon, removed or damaged the tunnels infrastructure or tunnel equipment]_
(D)_[removed, moved or otherwise interfered with the tunnel or machinery, apparatus, tools or other things in use or intended for use in connection with the tunnel]_
(E)_[posted a bill, placard or notice on tunnel infrastructure or equipment]_
(F)_[wrote, printed, drew or painted on or cut, marked or stamped the tunnel infrastructure or equipment]_
(G)_[fixed a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING FIXED..) to tunnel equipment or tunnel infrastructure,]_
(H)_[spat, urinated or defecated]_
(I)_[left litter or waste]_
(J)_[moved, altered, defaced or otherwise interfered with a notice belonging to Transport for London which was exhibited or placed there]_
(K)_[acted in a way, as to cause a nuisance in the tunnel]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 4 of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnel Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
whilst in Blackwall Tunnel area / Silvertown Tunnel area
climbed upon / removed/damaged tunnel infrastructure or tunnel equipment OR
removed / moved / otherwise interfered with the tunnel or machinery, apparatus, tools or other things in use or intended for use in connection with the tunnel OR
posted a bill / placard / notice on tunnel infrastructure or tunnel equipment OR
wrote / printed / drew / painted on/cut/marked/stamped tunnel infrastructure or tunnel equipment OR
fixed a thing to tunnel equipment or tunnel infrastructure OR
spat / urinated / defecated in the tunnel areas OR
left litter / waste in the tunnel areas OR
moved / altered/defaced / otherwise interfered with a notice belonging to TfL which was exhibited or placed in the tunnel areas OR
without prejudice to any other requirement of these byelaws, acted in any way as to cause a nuisance in the tunnel

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
